title: Personal Loans AutoPay Timing and Automatic Cancellation Figures
content:
The AutoPay timing figures of Personal Loans are the same in every grade, Personal Loan Grade A through Personal Loan Grade G.

| Item | Every grade |
|---|---|
| Set-up lead time before a due date | 3 business days |
| Cancellation notice before a scheduled debit | 3 business days |
| Consecutive returned AutoPay debits that cancel AutoPay automatically | 2 |

## Definitions

- **Set-up lead time**: business days before a due date by which AutoPay must be set up to debit that installment.
- **Cancellation notice**: business days before a scheduled debit by which an AutoPay cancellation must be received to stop that debit.
- **Consecutive returns to cancel**: consecutive returned AutoPay debits after which AutoPay is cancelled automatically (integer).

## Reading the figures (hypothetical calendar of business days)

With a due date on a business day and no holidays in the days before it, an enrollment set up three business days before that due date meets the lead time; one set up two business days before it does not. A cancellation received three business days before a scheduled debit meets the notice; one received the business day before it does not.
